svg.title: the leg, inside the silhouette
svg.desc: Proposed assembly: proximal motors, rigid knee drive, structural shell halves and supported metal pivots. Exterior concept only; motor packaging, transmission and structural performance are unverified.
svg.text: oddstride / industrial design
the leg, inside the silhouette
Proposed assembly: proximal motors, rigid knee drive, structural shell halves and supported metal pivots.
tinfox · design development
170 mm links / all RS-02 / concept, not validated CAD
CONSTRUCTION / 07
01 / proximal actuation + rigid linkage
Side schematic. Outer shell removed; pose is illustrative.
The shell is part of the load path.
Ribs and bolted edge flanges join the two curved halves into a box.
Metal carriers spread pivot and motor loads into both halves.
Rod clearance, knee travel and leverage require a full motion sweep.
No constant reduction ratio or payload capacity is established.
02 / structural sandwich section
Section across the thigh. Fasteners and rod occupy separate stations.

g.text: Continuous ribs join each skin to its flange.
Clamp metal, limiting compression of plastic.
Allow for motion, deflection and tolerances.

svg.text: The skins are removable structural parts; both must be installed for operation.
Metal bearing carriers bridge the halves at each pivot. Captured nuts and
compression sleeves carry joint clamping loads. Shell thickness, rib spacing
and print orientation remain subject to load and fatigue tests.
03 / pivot support + motor mounting
Knee section: a fork supports the shin hub on both sides.
At the hip: a supported roll cradle carries the hip-pitch motor.
The proximal knee motor bolts to a metal plate on the thigh root.
Use motor mounting faces, bearing carriers and a conductive heat path.
Resolve bolt access, cable loops, cooling and housing clearance in CAD.
